query:
SELECT c.id as "id!: uuid::Uuid",
                      c.title as "title!: String",
                      c.case_number as "case_number!: String",
                      c.created_by as "created_by!: uuid::Uuid"
               FROM cases c
               JOIN case_assignments ca ON ca.case_id = c.id
               WHERE ca.user_id = $1
               ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
